name: Decathlon US Shop
description: Search and browse Decathlon's US online store from Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot through its official shopping endpoint: product search with price filters, product details with sizes and live availability, and questions about shipping, returns and store policies. No account or API key; cart and checkout tools install switched off.
instructions:
## Decathlon US Shop
This connector bridges the **official shopping endpoint of Decathlon's US online store** (`https://www.decathlon.com/api/ucp/mcp`), an MCP server that speaks the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) and runs on Shopify. It covers the catalog of decathlon.com only: sports gear, clothing and shoes sold and shipped in the United States, with prices in US dollars. Other Decathlon country sites are not behind this endpoint.

**Setup**: nothing to enter. No Decathlon account, no API key and no sign-in are needed; install the connector and it works. Every call tells Decathlon which agent is asking by sending the address of AnythingMCP's public agent profile (`https://anythingmcp.com/.well-known/ucp-agent.json`); the connector adds it by itself, so it never appears as a tool parameter.

**The tools come from the server.** At install AnythingMCP asks Decathlon for its tools, so you get the current set. Open the connector and click **Discover tools** to pick up new ones later.

**Where to start**: `decathlon_shop_search_catalog` with what the user is looking for in `catalog.query` ("hiking backpack 30 l", "kids bike helmet"). Narrow with `catalog.filters.price.min` and `max` (in US cents) and page with `catalog.pagination.cursor`. `decathlon_shop_get_product` gives one product with sizes, colours and live availability; `decathlon_shop_lookup_catalog` refreshes several products or variants by id in one call. `decathlon_shop_ask_business` answers questions about the store itself: shipping, returns, policies, services.

**Prices**: every amount is an integer in minor units with a currency code. `amount` 2500 with `currency` USD is $25.00: divide by 100 before quoting a price. The same holds for filters: `price.max` 5000 means up to $50.00.

**Ids** are Shopify global ids: `gid://shopify/Product/...` for products and `gid://shopify/ProductVariant/...` for variants. Always pass them exactly as a previous answer returned them. Each product carries the `url` of its page on decathlon.com: give it to the user to look at or buy the product.

**Carts and checkout are switched off at install.** The server also offers `decathlon_shop_create_cart`, `decathlon_shop_update_cart`, `decathlon_shop_cancel_cart`, `decathlon_shop_create_checkout`, `decathlon_shop_update_checkout`, `decathlon_shop_cancel_checkout` and `decathlon_shop_complete_checkout`. They change things at the store, and `decathlon_shop_complete_checkout` places a real order and charges a payment method, so none of them is available until an administrator turns it on for this connector. Decathlon's own rule is that an order is placed and payment submitted only with the buyer's authorization. The safe default is to find the product here and send the user to its page on decathlon.com to buy it. The read tools `decathlon_shop_get_cart`, `decathlon_shop_get_checkout` and `decathlon_shop_get_order` stay on; without an account they only answer for an id you already have.

**Limits and pitfalls**:
- US store only: availability, prices and delivery are those of decathlon.com in the United States.
- A search needs a query, filters, or both. Results come 10 at a time unless `catalog.pagination.limit` says otherwise.
- `decathlon_shop_ask_business` has no memory: ask a complete question each time.
- The store asks agents to slow down on HTTP 429 and to respect `Retry-After`.
- An error `profile_unreachable` or `UCP discovery failed` means Decathlon could not read the agent profile address; it is not a problem with the search itself.
prerequisites: Nothing: no Decathlon account and no API key. It covers Decathlon's US store (decathlon.com) only.

verifyHints.422: Decathlon could not read the agent profile this connector sends with every call. That is on the AnythingMCP side, not a setting of yours: try again later.
verifyHints.429: Decathlon is limiting requests from this address. Wait for the Retry-After seconds and try again.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Decathlon is limiting requests from this address. Wait for the Retry-After seconds and try again.

tools.name: decathlon_shop_search_catalog
tools.description: Search the Decathlon US online store by free text, by filters, or both (at least one is needed). Put the text in `catalog.query`; narrow with `catalog.filters` (`categories`, `price.min` and `price.max` in US cents, `available`). Returns products with id, title, description, price range, options, variants (price, availability, SKU, checkout link), images and the product page URL, plus `pagination` with `has_next_page` and a `cursor`: pass it as `catalog.pagination.cursor` for the next page; `catalog.pagination.limit` sets the page size (10 by default). Money is an integer in minor units next to a currency code: amount 2500 with currency USD is $25.00.

context.description: Buyer signals for localization and personalization.

address_country.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

language.description: Language tag in IETF BCP 47 format.

categories.description: Category filters combined with OR logic.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units.

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units.

available.description: Filter by availability. Default true (only sale-ready items).

tools.name: decathlon_shop_lookup_catalog
tools.description: Look up several products or variants of the Decathlon US store in one call. `catalog.ids` takes product ids (`gid://shopify/Product/...`, answered with the featured variant) and variant ids (`gid://shopify/ProductVariant/...`, answered with the parent product and that exact variant). Results are grouped by product, and each variant says which requested id it answers. Use it to refresh prices and availability of products found earlier. Money is an integer in minor units next to a currency code: amount 2500 with currency USD is $25.00.

Pass the options the buyer chose in `catalog.selected` (name and label) to narrow the variants. Money is an integer in minor units next to a currency code: amount 2500 with currency USD is $25.00.

tools.name: decathlon_shop_ask_business
tools.description: Ask Decathlon US a question in plain language in `ask.query`: what it sells, shipping, returns, policies, services. Returns `answer.plain` with the text and `links` to the pages it is based on. `ask.ids` can name up to 10 products, variants or collections of this store to ground the answer. Follow-up conversations are not supported: ask a complete question each time.

conversation.description: Opaque conversation identifier. Multi-turn conversations are not currently supported.

ids.description: Resource identifiers for grounding. Up to 10 of this store's Shopify Product, ProductVariant, Collection or Cart GIDs are supported. A cart or collection grounds the answer in its products.

context.description: Buyer context for localization and personalization.

signals.description: Platform environment data. Signals are not currently supported.

attribution.description: Platform attribution data. Attribution is not currently supported.

ask.description: The question and what it is about: `query` (the question in plain language), optional `ids` and `context`.

tools.name: decathlon_shop_get_cart
tools.description: Read a cart of the Decathlon US store by its id (`gid://shopify/Cart/...`): line items with quantities, totals, the buyer details and discount codes it holds, when it expires and the `continue_url` where the buyer can go on in the browser. Only carts created through this connector can be read: there is no account behind it. Money is an integer in minor units next to a currency code: amount 2500 with currency USD is $25.00.

id.description: The ID of the cart. Format: 'gid://shopify/Cart/abc123'

tools.name: decathlon_shop_create_cart
tools.description: Create a cart at the Decathlon US store from `cart.line_items` (a variant id and a quantity each). Returns the cart with its id, line items, totals and a `continue_url` the buyer can open to continue on decathlon.com. Nothing is bought or paid. Money is an integer in minor units next to a currency code: amount 2500 with currency USD is $25.00. Ask the buyer before calling it; it installs switched off.
